title: The Obamas: The Most Powerful Black Family In The World
fullText: in the heart of a chilly Illinois Dawn Barack Obama began his journey Chicago lay behind him its Skyline a glittering promise on the horizon while Springfield awaited his arrival with its own demands and dreams indeed the 200m drive stretching over three and a half monotonous hours lay before him like a metaphor for his life long challenging but filled with purpose but the road to Springfield was more than asphalt and distance as the miles rolled by barck found solace in the hum of the engine and the rhythmic passing of the highway markers envisioning family life back in Chicago where Michelle held down the fort she was his Rock managing their home with the same precision and care she brought to her roles in the community and at the University of Chicago Medical Center and their daughters Malia and Sasha were the heartbeats that kept them grounded and yet how did this humble beginning lead to the rise of an African-American dynasty of unparalleled influence in today's episode we'll take you on a journey that spans the entire Globe from the sunny shores of Hawaii to the temperate Sands of Africa all the way to the south side of Chicago as we describe the Obamas the most powerful black family in the world in 2024 the Obamas are living proof that being the former first family comes with perks Galore and then some and with a jaw-dropping $70 million net worth Barack and Michelle Obama have transformed their post-presidency years into to a dazzling display of financial prowess indeed they've not just sat back and basked in past Glory they've leaped into the Realms of book deals high-profile speeches Media Ventures and real estate ensuring their legacy is far from a mere historical footnote for example barack's Memoirs are not just bests sellers they're publishing Juggernauts and his Opus a Promised Land commanded a colossal $65 million deal while Michelle's becoming has shifted over 15 million copies and their Netflix production company Higher Ground Productions hasn't just enhanced their brand it snagged an Oscar for American Factory furthermore their speaking fees have mushroomed to an impressive $400,000 a pop add bro's annual presidential pension of over $200,000 covering health insurance and Secret Service and their financial portfolio would make even Wall Street do a double take and it should go without saying that their residences are the epitome of opulence for instance the Obama's Primary Home in Washington DC's ritzy calorama neighborhood is an 8.1 million Masterpiece from the 1920s featuring nine bedrooms8 and a half bathrooms and Lush Gardens undoubtedly it strikes the perfect balance between seclusion and access to the political heart of the US there Martha's Vineyard estate is no less extravagant clocking in at $1.75 million this 29 acre hay Haven boasts a nearly 7,000 ft main house with seven bedrooms 8 and 1 half bathrooms and an array of stone fireplaces with sweeping Atlantic views a swimming pool a two-car garage a separate barn and a boat house it's a luxurious Retreat from the frenetic pace of public life and in Hyde Park Chicago their former home stands as a Sentimental Cornerstone this is where the Obama Journey began and their ties to the city remain strong through community initiatives and the Obama Presidential Center a project aimed at inspiring Future Leaders yet even in their well healed bubble the Obamas are never Out Of Reach of the US Secret Service the agency's protective measures are legendary at least for certain political candidates when working for the Obamas they use secure perimeters coordinate with local law enforcement and use Cutting Edge surveillance systems and neutralize threats before they can even get close their code name Barack is Renegade and Michelle is Renaissance add a dash of Glamour to their already glittering lifestyle proving their security is as sophisticated as their celebrity additionally with even years away from the White House the Obamas are still heavyweight contenders in global politics and media former president Barack Obama remains a towering presence in political discourse and his approval ratings according to Pew Research Center are still Skyhigh high with a majority of Americans holding him in high regard consistently eclipsing those of many current political figures including President Joe Biden vice president Cela Harris and former president Donald Trump and Michelle Obama's popularity is equally formidable a recent ipsos poll revealed that she enjoys a favorability rating surpassing both Biden and Trump by over 10 percentage points this widespread admiration underscores the Obama's lasting impact and charm in this regard Barack Obama's impact on the 2024 election is particularly noteworthy rumor has it that his influence played a role in President Joe Biden's decision to step aside and while solid evidence is elusive many speculate that Obama's sway within the Democratic party might have influenced Biden's Choice moreover there's chatter that Obama had a preference for another candidate but eventually backed Kamala Harris to unite the party and strengthen the Democratic front for the upcoming election thus this endorsement wasn't merely a gesture it was a strategic move underscoring their continued influence and commitment to shaping the political landscape and yet you're probably wondering how a quiet bookish Hawaiian and a star student from the south side of Chicago got together to create the most powerful black family in the world in order to get the full picture let's go all the way back to the beginnings of the Obama and Robinson families in the next chapter the roots of Barack Obama's family stretched back to the 19th century beginning with his great great grandfather opio who was born around 1830 near Lake Victoria in Africa and op's lineage is marked by significant transitions most notably with his son onyango born around 1895 who became the grandfather of none other than Barack Obama senior interestingly this patal ancestor of the future commander-in-chief named onyango embraced Islam adopting the name Hussein onyango Obama and pursued a dual role as a mission cook and local herbalist soon his marriage to one habba akumu produced Barack Obama senior the father of the future president now the luo people to whom Obama's ancestors belonged are a nilotic ethnic group native to the regions surrounding Western Kenya and Northern Tanzania their migration from Uganda into Kenya spanned several centuries a journey intertwined with the migrations of relation groups such as the acholi and padola the luo practiced a varied subsistence strategy combining cattle herding farming fishing and hunting and spoke Doo a language closely related to those of other luo communities by the 19th century the luo had established themselves in Kenya gradually developing a distinct cultural and political identity their influence grew steadily and by the 1960s they had become a formidable presence in the newly independent nation of of Kenya now the future president's father Barack Obama senior was born on the 18th of June 1936 in the rachuonyo district of British Kenya he grew up in the village of nanga Kelo within the ca district and at the age of six he converted from Islam to anglicanism while attending a missionary School changing his name from Baraka to Barak his parents' separation when he was nine led to his upbringing under the care of his stepmother Sarah a well and then Obama senior's educational Journey took him through various institutions including the prestigious Anglican boarding school maseno National School his academic proess led him to marry his first wife kzia aoko in 1954 with whom he had two children whom we'll discuss in depth in a little while as members of the broader Obama Clan soon Barry senior's educational achievements in 1959 earned him a place in a special program which brought him to the United States for studies at the University of Hawaii at monoa in Honolulu thus leading him to cross paths with a white woman named Stanley Anne Dunham who would later become the mother of Barack Obama the 44th President of the United States now Stanley Anne Dunham was born on the 29th of November 1942 in witchar Kansas as the only child of Stanley Arma Dunham and melin Lee pay Dunham and her father's decision to name her Stanley despite her being a girl was a source of mild confusion and teasing during her Youth and though Dunham's Family Heritage was a mix of English with other notable Germanic elements her lineage included John punch an African-American man condemned to slavery in 1640 interestingly making her a direct descendant of one of America's earliest documented slaves but Stanley Anne's parents Kansas natives met and married in witchar in 1940 and after the attack on Pearl Harbor her father enlisted in the Army and her mother took up work at a Boeing plant post World War II the family relocated multiple times across California Oklahoma Texas and Kansas before settling in Seattle Washington in 1955 there Stanley Anne attended Nathan ex junior high school and graduated from Mercer Island High School in 1960 before beginning her studies at the University of Hawaii at monoa that same year it was in this setting that she met Barack Obama senior in a Russian language class of all places setting in motion the events that would shape the future of the Obama family now Stanley and Dunham and Barack Obama senior's marriage encountered significant opposition from both their families driven by cultural racial and personal concerns and their Union emerging in an era when many states still prohibited interracial marriages was both bold and contentious for example Dunham's par parents Stanley Arma Dunham and meline Lee Payne Dunham were initially unsettled by their daughter's relationship with Obama senior originally from Kansas the Dunhams had relocated to Hawaii seeking new opportunities but despite their move they held traditional views and the idea of their daughter Marrying an African man was disquieting their worries were Amplified by the fact that Dunham was only 18 and 3 months pregnant when she married Obama senior raising doubts about the stability and future of the marriage but Obama senior's family in Kenya also had their reservations you see he had left behind a wife kesia aoko and their two children and although he informed Dunham that he was divorced this wasn't true specifically luo culture required a complex divorce process involving a Council of Elders and the return of the dowy which had not been completed this cultural backdrop LED his family to view his marriage with skepticism worried about his responsibility in Kenya and the potential neglect of his first family furthermore the cultural divide between the two families was profound Dunham's parents were concerned about the racial prejudices their daughter and Grandson would face in a predominantly white Society at the same time Obama senior's family worried about the cultural dissonance and his obligations in Kenya additionally as their relationship evolved personal Dynamics between Dunham and Obama senior shifted initially marked by Mutual ad admiration their marriage soon faced strains and Obama senior's attitude reportedly became more demanding and less considerate leading to tensions for instance an incident where he through a meal Dunham had prepared highlighted the growing Discord and the physical separation with Dunham moving to Seattle with their newborn son while Obama senior remained in Hawaii further strained their marriage often as they say long distance is the wrong distance it was within this culturally expansive and yet internally divisive context that Barack Hussein Obama II was born on the 4th of August 1961 in Honolulu Hawaii and shortly after his birth his father left for Harvard University with his parents marriage ending when he was 2 years old but his mother later married Lolo sworo an Indonesian student and the family moved to Jakarta when Obama was six in Indonesia Obama attended both Catholic and Muslim schools experiencing a unique cultural and religious environment partially due to his mother a staunch liberal instilling in him a belief in the value of civil rights and social justice yet despite jakarta's vibrant life Obama returned to Honolulu in 1971 to live with his maternal grandparents and attend puno school an Elite Preparatory Academy certainly this period was crucial in shaping his identity as he grappled with understanding what he felt it meant to be a black man in America a journey he later detailed in dreams from my father at puno Obama was known for his intellect and athleticism especially in basketball yet he faced racial isolation being one of the few African-American students and his mixed Heritage and the absence of his father added layers of complexity to his self-identity despite these challenges Obama excelled academically graduating in 1979 next Obama's College years were marked by significant growth he started at ocidental College in Los Angeles engaging with political and social issues and he then transferred to Columbia University in New York City graduating in 1983 with a degree in political science after undergrad Obama worked for a year at business International Group in New York before seeking more meaningful work by moving to Chicago in 1985 to become a community organizer on the Southside there he worked with low-income residents to improve living conditions and set up job training programs experiences that deepened his understanding of urban African-American struggles and solidified his commitment to Public Service then in 1988 Obama enrolled at Harvard Law School where he became the first African-American president of the Harvard Law review and his time at Harvard brought national attention and led to a book contract resulting in dreams from my father during a summer internship at the Chicago Law Firm sidley Austin in 1989 Obama met Michelle Robinson a fellow Harvard Law graduate initially skeptical Michelle was eventually won over by barack's persistance and their first date a visit to the Art Institute of Chicago and a movie Marked the beginning of a partnership that would become Central to both their personal and professional lives now Michelle Obama's own ancestry reveals a complex history her maternal great great great grandmother melvinia Shields was enslaved in South Carolina before being moved to Northern Georgia melvinia had a child Dolphus Shields with Charles Marian Shields the son of her owner Dolphus Shields later moved to Birmingham Alabama where he married Alice Easley and had a son named Robert Lee Shields and Robert Lee shields' son penel Shields eventually relocated to Chicago with his mother reflecting The Great Migration this era spanning from the early 20th century to the 1970s saw millions of African-Americans move from the rural Sou to Urban centers in the north and west in search of better economic opportunities and to escape the conditions of Jim Crow segregation thus Michelle lvon Robinson known as Michelle Obama was born on the 17th of January 1964 in Chicago and she grew up in a tight-knit family on the south side with her father working as a pump operator and her mother emphasizing education Michelle excelled academically skipping the second grade attending Whitney M Young young Magnet High School and later graduating kumla from Princeton University she then earned her jurist doctor degree from Harvard Law School in 1988 before returning to Chicago where Michelle worked at sidley Austin and meeting Barack Obama therefore their eventual marriage marked the beginning of a journey that would lead them to the White House driven by shared values and mutual support on the 3rd of October 1992 Michelle and Barack Obama exchanged vows at the Trinity United Church of Christ in Chicago and their early years together were a blend of professional achievement and personal growth Barack began his legal career as an associate at Davis Miner Barnhill and Gallard where he focused on voting rights cases meanwhile Michelle transitioned from corporate law to nonprofit work and Academia eventually becoming the associate dean of student services at the University of Chicago now in 1996 roughly four years into their marriage Barack entered the political Arena as the elected representative of Illinois's 13th District in the state senate and his tenure was defined by efforts to reform ethics and Health Care laws enhance tax credits for low-income families and expand Child Care subsidies his re-elections in 1998 and 2002 underscored his growing influence in Illinois politics however the Obamas faced their own set of Trials during these years Michelle experienced a miscarriage and the couple in their desire to expand their family turned to invitro fertilization leading to the births of Malia in 1998 and Sasha in 2001 and despite the pressures of barack's burgeoning political career the Obamas worked to maintain a stable home life for their daughters they kept their residence in Chicago to provide consistency for Malia and Sasha even as barack's responsibilities demanded frequent travel Michelle balanced her career with her role as a mother often making sacrifices to support barack's Ambitions while ensuring their daughters were well cared for and barack's political Ascent continued though not without setbacks in 2000 his bid for the US House of Representatives against incumbent Bobby Rush ended in defeat yet this did not deter him and the 2004 Democratic National Convention became a defining moment for Barack you see on the 27th of July 2004 in Boston he delivered a keynote address that captured the nation's attention his speech urging National unity and emphasizing common values marked a departure from the conventional political discourse and it was here that he famously declared there is not a liberal America and a conservative America there's the United States of America following the convention Obama's visibility soar and his Memoir dreams from my father was reissued and became a bestseller solidifying his position position within the Democratic party subsequently in November 2004 Obama achieved a resounding victory in the US Senate race against Republican Alan Keys capturing 70% of the vote sworn into office in January 2005 he quickly made an impact with his work on ethics reform health care and Veterans Benefits co-sponsoring the secure America and orderly Immigration Act ironically with his future opponent Senator John McCain during his Senate years Obama penned The Audacity Of Hope published in October 2006 and this book outlining his political Vision garnered widespread Acclaim and speculation about his presidential aspirations despite growing interest Obama remained focused on his Senate duties yet nonetheless the momentum for a presidential bid was unmistakable by October during an interview on Meet the Press Obama acknowledged serious consideration of a presidential run thus a few short months later on the 10th of February 2007 Obama officially declared his candidacy for the presidency in Springfield Illinois at the old state capital the site of Abraham Lincoln's famous house divided speech and from the beginning Obama's campaign was characterized by its focus on Hope change and unity his message resonated across a diverse electorate particularly among young voters and minorities furthermore the the Innovative use of social media and Grassroots organizing was Central to his campaign success creating an expansive network of supporters and volunteers but the Democratic primary was fiercely competitive with Obama facing off against several seasoned politicians notably Senator Hillary Clinton and indeed the contest between Obama and Clinton was one of the most intense primaries in recent history yet Obama's victory in the Iowa caucuses on in Jan January 2008 was a crucial early Triumph that confirmed his status as a serious Contender the primary season continued to be a hard-fought battle with Obama and Clinton exchanging victories but by the 3rd of June Obama had amassed sufficient delegates to secure the nomination at the Democratic National Convention in August he accepted the nomination with a stirring address that energized his supporters for the general election Obama selected Senator Joe Biden of Delaware as his running mate facing the Republican ticket of Senator John McCain and Governor Sarah Palin and the campaign was marked by aggressive advertising and frequent debates but a turning point emerged in September 2008 with the onset of the global financial crisis Obama's calm and measured response contrasted with McCain's more erratic approach including a temporary suspension of his campaign and this difference in leadership style was pivotal in solidifying Obama's lead in the polls additionally throughout the campaign Obama's team excelled in both traditional and New Media their strategic use of Television advertising and social media helped them raise unprecedented amounts of money allowing them to outspend McCain in crucial Battleground States as election day approached polls consistently favored Obama consequently on the 4th of November 2008 with record voter turnout Obama won decisively as he carried key swing States such as Florida Ohio and Virginia as well as traditionally Republican states like Indiana and North Carolina in total he secured 365 electoral votes to McCain's 173 winning 53% of the popular vote that night in a poignant moment Obama addressed a crowd of 250,000 people in Grant Park Chicago marking both the culmination of his campaign and the start of a new chapter in American history with without a doubt Barack Obama's Triumph in the 2008 presidential election marked a historic moment in American history as the first African-American President Obama's victory was both a political and cultural Milestone and the global reaction to Obama's election was one of immense enthusiasm around the world his victory was hailed as a symbol of democratic potential and a new chapter in American leadership in Kenya where Obama's father was from the day was marked by public celebration and declared a national holiday similar festivities unfolded in Indonesia and Japan as people gathered to watch the inauguration and celebrate its historic significance and Obama's inauguration on the 20th of January 2009 was a historic event drawing an unprecedented 1.8 million attendees to the National Mall in Washington DC the ceremony's theme a new birth of Freedom paid tribute to Abraham Lincoln and emphasized the ideals of ual and unity that Obama aimed to represent yet when Barack Obama assumed the presidency on that faithful day he inherited a nation grappling with the severe repercussions of the Great Recession in the first 100 days of Barack Obama's presidency the country's economic turmoil was palpable and the newly inaugurated president's Administration wasted no time in addressing the crisis Central to their efforts was the American Recovery and reinvestment act a sweeping $787 billion stimulus package designed to jolt the economy back to life but this ambitious plan alongside the troubled asset relief program or top for short initiated under President George W bush became a focal point of contention you see Obama who had previously endorsed tarp as a senator took a proactive role in securing additional funds lobbying vigorously to extend the bailout with an extra 350 billion and this move intended to stabilize the financial sector was met with criticism detractors argued that the bailout disproportionately favored large financial institutions leaving average Americans facing foreclosures and unemployment largely unassisted meetings between Obama and Bank Executives coupled with his administration's reluctance to impose restrictions on Executive bonuses at firms like AIG fueled the perception that his policies prioritized Wall Street over Main Street indeed Obama's administration's strong support for big banks financial interventions led to accusations of an excessive alignment with Wall Street interests and continues to be a thorn in the side of the Obama Legacy now Michelle Obama assuming the role of first lady in 2009 initially approached her new position with caution concerned about preserving a sense of normaly for her daughters Malia and Sasha however she soon embrace ered her role with Vigor launching several impactful initiatives one of her early Endeavors was the creation of a vegetable garden on the south lawn of the White House in April 2009 and this Garden laid the groundwork for her let's move Campaign which she officially launched in 2010 to address childhood obesity the initiative emphasized healthy eating and physical activity for children reflecting Michelle's commitment to Public Health meanwhile Malia and Sasha aged 10 and 7 when they moved into the White House experienced an extraordinary upbringing the Obama Administration made efforts to safeguard their privacy while allowing them a semblance of ordinary childhood experiences and they attended Sidwell Friends School in Washington DC participating in sports and music despite the constant presence of Secret Service protection heartwarmingly the president often remarked on how the girls in their pajamas and seeking bedtime stories transformed the White House into a true family home then as the economy showed signs of recovery Obama shifted Focus toward healthc care reform culminating in the passage of the Affordable Care Act informly known as Obamacare in March 2010 this Landmark legislation aimed to expand healthc care coverage and reduce costs becoming one of his signature achievements however it also attracted considerable opposition in addition to the Affordable Care Act Obama pursued a series of Domes IC policy reforms the dodf Frank Wall Street reform and consumer protection act signed into law in July 2010 represented the most extensive overhaul of financial regulations since the Great Depression and it sought to prevent another financial crisis by enhancing oversight of financial institutions and establishing the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau another notable achievement was the repeal of don't ask don't tell in December 2010 allowing lgbtq plus individuals to serve openly in the military this significant policy shift fulfilled a campaign promise that would later see even more legislative advancement in his second term lastly as his first term neared its end Obama introduced the deferred action for childhood arrivals or Daka program in June 2012 Dhaka aimed to defer deportations and provide work authorization to Young undocumented immigrants commonly referred to as dreamers who had been brought to the US as children the program designed as a temporary measure allowed nearly 900,000 individuals to obtain legal employment in the US specifically it required that applicants arrived in the US before their 16th birthday resided continuously in the country since the 15th of June 2007 and met educational or military service requirements but while many viewed daa as a compassionate response to a pressing issue critics argued that Obama had exceeded his executive Authority and circumvented the legislative process and in matters of National Security Obama's presidency saw a marked expansion of surveillance programs and his stance evolved significantly from his earlier criticisms of the Bush administration's surveillance practices by 2012 he signed a 5-year extension of the fiser Amendments act which he had once opposed and this shift became more pronounced in June 200 3 when Edward Snowden revealed the extent of NSA surveillance under Obama's administration snowden's disclosures exposed the collection of telephone records of millions of Americans and the monitoring of major internet company servers initially defending these practices as essential for National Security and subject to oversight Obama later acknowledged the need for reforms proposing changes to the nsa's telephone metadata program in January 2014 then Obama's first term also involved a challenging re-election campaign with the economy recovering only slowly he faced Mitt Romney the former Governor of Massachusetts who criticized his economic policies and promised job creation through tax cuts and reduced government spending Obama's campaign leveraging Advanced Digital strategies and social media maintained a clear Edge over Romney's more traditional approach while Romney briefly gained ground after a strong performance in the first presidential debate Obama rebounded in subsequent debates and garnered a boost from his response to super storm Sandy then on the second of November 2012 Obama secured his second term with a decisive Victory but this election saw record-breaking campaign financing and negative advertising underscoring the intense nature of the contest as Obama began his second term on the 20th of January 2013 he faced ongoing challenges the issues of economic recovery health Healthcare reform and a polarized political landscape loomed large setting the stage for the next phase of his presidency Barack Obama's second term as president of the United States from 2013 to 2017 was a period marked by substantial achievements and significant controversies reflecting a complex phase in American history you see at the outset of his second term Obama concentrated on economic recovery but the US economy still grappling with the effects of the Great Recession began to show signs of improvement by the second quarter of 2015 the economy had grown by 3.7% and the unemployment rate had decreased to 5.1% indicating a strong rebound and on the international stage Obama achieved notable diplomatic successes one of the most prominent was the Iran nuclear deal a landmark agreement aimed at preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons in exch for lifting economic sanctions this deal marked a shift towards diplomacy over military action another significant achievement was the restoration of diplomatic relations with Cuba ending Decades of hostility and opening a new chapter in US Cuba relations despite these successes Obama's second term was fraught with controversy for example the administration's expanded use of drone strikes became a major issue during his presidency drone strikes increased significantly ly with 563 strikes targeting countries such as Pakistan Somalia and Yemen indeed this was a sharp rise from the 57 strikes carried out under George W bush thus the expansion of drone Warfare led to criticism due to high civilian casualties and ethical concerns about the classification of military age males in strike zones as combatants the Drone program faced intense scrutiny for its high civilian toll and legal and moral implications the administration's policy of assuming all military age males in a strike zone were combatants unless proven otherwise poly Drew particular criticism and this approach was seen as potentially inflating combatant casualties and Under reporting civilian deaths in response to Growing criticism Obama introduced a near certainty standard in 2013 requiring near certainty that no civilians would be harmed before authorizing a strike this policy shift aimed to address concerns about the ethics and legality of drone strikes nonetheless independent estimates suggested that between 384 and 807 civilians were killed in these strikes during Obama's presidency while the White House's own figures released Under Pressure estimated between 64 and 116 civilian deaths yet domestically Obama made significant strides on social issues his evolving stance on same-sex marriage culminated in the Supreme Court's 2015 decision in obber jaell versus Hodges which legalized same-sex marriage Nationwide this was a major victory for the lgbtq plus community and a defining achievement of Obama's presidency and throughout These Years Michelle Obama continued her work as first lady while focusing on raising their daughters Malia and Sasha Michelle remained committed to her initiatives particularly the let's move Campaign which sour significant growth including a partnership with the US Olympic Committee in 2012 to introduce athletic programming for millions of children by 2016 nearly 2 million children had participated in these programs and Malia and Sasha grew up under the public eye during this period with Malia graduating from high school in 2016 and choosing to take a gap year before starting at Harvard University during this time she traveled to Liberia and Morocco to support the let girls learn initiative focusing on girls education globally Sasha continued her high school education maintaining a relatively private life while excelling in her studies and extracurricular activities yet the second term also faced controversies that tested the administration the 2012 Benghazi attack which resulted in the deaths of four Americans including Ambassador Chris Stevens led to investigations and criticism of the administration's handling of the incident additionally the IRS scandal which involved targeting conservative groups for extra scrutiny and the Justice Department's seizure of phone records from the Associated Press raised concerns about governmental overreach and press Freedom specifically Obama's use of executive actions to overcome Congressional gridlock Drew sharp criticism from opponents who viewed these measures as overreach as the 2016 presidential election approached Obama was deeply involved in supporting Hillary Clinton and his endorsement in June 2016 marked a significant shift from their earlier rivalry and he campaigned vigorously for her emphasizing the importance of continuing the progress made during his presidency however the campaign was disrupted by the FBI's announcement of a renewed investigation into Clinton's emails shortly before the election impacting the campaign's momentum therefore on the 8th of November 2016 Donald Trump's unexpected victory was a blow to Obama and his administration who had hoped to see Clinton continue their legacy in his final weeks Obama focused on securing his legacy through executive actions including Banning oil drilling off the Atlantic coast and establishing new Environmental Protections his presidency concluded with a farewell address in Chicago where he urged Americans to remain hopeful and engaged in the Democratic process after leaving office on the 20th of January 2017 the Obamas embarked on a vacation starting with a stay in the British Virgin Islands with billionaire Richard Branson and then moving to French Polynesia during this period Barack Obama began working on his Memoir marking a transition from the intense pressures of the presidency to a more relaxed phase of his life the Obama family is often viewed through the lens of Barack Michelle and their daughters Malia and Sasha yet this immediate family is part of a broader Network each member contributing to a rich interconnected story Michelle Obama's family includes her older brother Craig Robinson a significant figure in his own right born in April 1962 in Calumet Park Illinois Craig Robinson emerged as a notable basketball player during his time at Princeton University and there he achieved distinction as a two-time ivy league Player of the Year and ranked as the fourth highest scorer in the school's history after earning a ba in sociology Robinson pursued profession basketball briefly in the UK before transitioning by recognition as ivy league coach of the Year by basketball ukom in 2017 Robinson shifted to sports Administration taking up executive roles with the Milwaukee Bucks and the New York Knicks by 2020 he had assumed the position of executive director of the National Association of Basketball Coaches yet despite his busy career Robinson has consistently been a steadfast supporter of his sister half siblings Maya satoro stands out as a close and supportive figure born in 1970 to barack's Mother Anne Dunham and her second husband Lolo sutoro Maya grew up with Barack in Hawaii she pursued a the Discord his Memoir big bad brother from Kenya coupled with issues surrounding the Barack H Obama has further fueled the controversy furthermore Malik's presence on Twitter has been particularly notable for its provocative nature he has frequently employed the platform to voice his dissatisfaction and disparage Barack and his tweets have been characterized by derogatory language and personal
